validity.value: Photo must be taken within the last six months

file_spec.value: Only original photographs are acceptable — copied or digitally scanned photos are not accepted; photos must not be digitally altered or retouched

headwear_policy.value: Hats or head coverings are not permitted, except veils for women; full facial features must be clearly visible

glasses_policy.value: Photos with dark, tinted, or mirrored glasses are not accepted

headwear.en: Hats or head coverings are not permitted, except veils for women; the full facial features must remain clearly visible.
headwear.ko: 모자나 머리 가리개 착용 불가. 단, 여성의 베일(히잡 등)은 예외이며, 이 경우에도 얼굴 윤곽 전체가 뚜렷하게 보여야 함.
headwear.ja: 帽子や頭部を覆うものの着用は不可。ただし女性のベール(ヴェール)は例外。その場合も顔の輪郭全体がはっきり見える必要あり。

glasses.en: Photos showing dark, tinted, or mirrored glasses are not accepted.
glasses.ko: 짙은 색·유색·미러(반사) 렌즈 안경을 착용한 사진은 접수 불가.
glasses.ja: 濃色・色付き・ミラーレンズの眼鏡を着用した写真は不可。

direct_fetch_note.note: Direct WebFetch to cglondon.mfa.gov.dz (and to other *.mfa.gov.dz subdomains tried as alternates) failed with a TLS chain-validation error ('unable to verify the first certificate') on every attempt — a technical fetch-tool limitation, not a content issue. Values above were confirmed via a grounded web search whose top, exactly-matching result (title: 'Passport photo requirements | Consulate General of Algerian in London') is this official Algerian MFA consular page, with specific verbatim quotes attributed to it. Additional supplementary detail seen elsewhere ('face centered, no head tilt/looking over shoulder') was not included above because it was not clearly separable from third-party aggregator text in the same result set.

head_height.note: A '75% of picture' / '32–36mm' figure appeared in some search results, but attribution was ambiguous between the official mfa.gov.dz page and commercial passport-photo aggregator sites (mybiometricphotos.com, visapics.org) that were mixed into the same result set. Not included as verified per the truthfulness gate.
